planner.description: Plans CodeIgniter/PHP implementation work with minimal, testable changes.

code-reviewer.description: Reviews PHP/CodeIgniter changes for correctness, security, maintainability, and missing tests.

security-reviewer.description: Reviews authentication, authorization, validation, file handling, and database changes for security risks.

build-error-resolver.description: Diagnoses and fixes Composer, PHPUnit, PHP syntax, and CodeIgniter runtime errors with minimal diffs.

migration-reviewer.description: Reviews and plans CI3-to-CI4 migration work across routes, controllers, models, views, database, and verification.

github-flow-operator.description: Prepares GitHub-ready summaries, PR notes, issue drafts, and release handoff details from local changes.

ui-ux-reviewer.description: Reviews CodeIgniter 4 views, layouts, frontend interactions, and responsive UX for this project.

plan.description: Create an implementation plan for CodeIgniter/PHP work.
plan.template: Create a concise implementation plan for this CodeIgniter 4 project: $ARGUMENTS

code-review.description: Review current changes for bugs, regressions, and missing tests.
code-review.template: Review the current worktree changes in this CodeIgniter 4 project. Focus on bugs, regressions, security, and missing tests. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

security.template: Security review this CodeIgniter 4 project area. Check auth, roles, CSRF, validation, uploads, SQL/query safety, secrets, and output escaping. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

build-fix.description: Fix PHP, Composer, PHPUnit, or CodeIgniter errors.
build-fix.template: Diagnose and fix this build/test/runtime issue with minimal CodeIgniter/PHP changes: $ARGUMENTS

verify.template: Verify the recent changes in this CodeIgniter 4 project. Prefer composer test or vendor/bin/phpunit when available, php -l for touched PHP files, and targeted manual checks. Report commands run and results. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

tdd.description: Guide test-first implementation for a bug fix or feature.
tdd.template: Use a test-first workflow for this CodeIgniter 4 change. Identify the smallest failing PHPUnit test, implement the minimal fix, then verify. Task: $ARGUMENTS

migration-scan.description: Map CI4 migration status across modules and identify gaps.
migration-scan.template: Scan this CodeIgniter 4 migration state. Compare routes, controllers, models, services, views, migrations, tests, and docs. Produce module status, gaps, risks, and next actions. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

migration-plan.description: Plan a focused CI3-to-CI4 module migration.
migration-plan.template: Create a focused CI3-to-CI4 migration plan for this module or feature. Include source/target files, data model impact, route/filter impact, validation, tests, rollback notes, and acceptance checks. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

migration-verify.description: Verify a migrated CI4 module before marking it complete.
migration-verify.template: Verify this migrated CodeIgniter 4 module. Check route coverage, controller behavior, models/services, views, validation, auth filters, database changes, tests, and manual QA. Report blockers before status can become complete. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

db-review.description: Review database migrations, models, queries, indexes, and data safety.
db-review.template: Review database-related CodeIgniter 4 migration work. Check migrations, model allowedFields/return types, transactions, indexes, query builder usage, destructive changes, rollback, seed/backfill needs, and data safety. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

release-audit.description: Audit migration readiness before release or handoff.
release-audit.template: Audit release readiness for this CodeIgniter 4 migration. Check open migration gaps, docs, tests, auth/security, database migration safety, environment assumptions, rollback plan, and manual QA. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

ui-review.description: Review UI consistency, responsive behavior, and frontend UX risks.
ui-review.template: Review the UI/UX of this CodeIgniter 4 project area. Focus on layout consistency, table/modal/form quality, responsive behavior, accessibility basics, misleading labels, and unfinished UI. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

ux-flow.description: Review end-to-end UX flow and user friction points.
ux-flow.template: Review the end-to-end UX flow for this CodeIgniter 4 project area or user journey. Focus on validation, redirects, feedback, failure states, edge cases, and user friction. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

github-pr.description: Prepare a GitHub-ready pull request summary for current changes.
github-pr.template: Prepare a GitHub pull request draft for the current worktree changes in this CodeIgniter 4 project. Include title, summary, affected modules, risks, tests, manual QA, and follow-up notes. Scope: $ARGUMENTS

github-issue.description: Prepare a GitHub issue draft for a bug, UX gap, or follow-up task.
github-issue.template: Prepare a GitHub issue draft for this CodeIgniter 4 project. Include summary, affected area, current problem, expected behavior, impact, and verification notes. Scope: $ARGUMENTS
